# Poly IA — constitutional Codex commissioning package

**Commission edition 1.0.0 · 24 October 2026 · Owner: Abed Kadaan**  
**Destination:** <https://github.com/akadaan310/PolyIA>  
**Runtime 1.4.0 · ledger schema 2 · full mission: `NOT_COMMISSIONED`**

**Runtime branch:** [`codex/commission-20261024-83906c7`](https://github.com/akadaan310/PolyIA/tree/codex/commission-20261024-83906c7). All package contents are extracted there; the default `main` branch retains the earlier import transport. Read the [current safe-checkpoint handoff](docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-24.md), then [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md) and [CODEX_START.md](CODEX_START.md). Commissioning stopped at the owner's request; the live service remains available.

This is the consolidated **Option A commission, explicitly including the B and C productions**: constitution, scientific foundations, vocabulary, division charters, source reconciliation, acceptance system, runnable state-machine harness, produce/verify lifecycle, acknowledged guidance, and working commissioning interface. It contains the retained sources, executable bootstrap, tests, deployment templates, and instructions for Codex to complete Poly IA and establish its continuing Automaton Science University mandate.

The state service is deployed on Oracle VM `ollama-a1`, with authenticated HTTPS, durable history, applied guidance and source-linked checkpoints. Runtime 1.4 adds typed forms, constructive generators and the durable machine client. Its finite checks and two accepted mission obligations do not complete the full Poly IA application. See [release evidence](docs/RELEASE_1_4_COMMISSIONING.md) and the current handoff for exact scope.

## 1. Start here

1. Clone or open the runtime branch named above. Start with [the handoff](docs/HANDOFF_2026-10-24.md) and [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md). Inspect existing work and preserve concurrent changes.
2. Read [GOD_SEED.md](GOD_SEED.md) completely and [CODEX_START.md](CODEX_START.md). The latter contains the copyable execution directive.
3. Check [source reconciliation](docs/SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md), [acceptance](docs/ACCEPTANCE_SYSTEM.md), and the [operator runbook](docs/OPERATOR_RUNBOOK.md).
4. Verify the package and inspect the existing service. Use disposable ledgers for tests; never replace the live ledger with a fresh demonstration. Schema-1 development databases are refused by this release.
5. On an explicit owner request to resume, use the start directive with actual project/VM access and continue from the retained source-linked checkpoint.

The current owner decision is recorded in [authority.json](registry/authority.json): **Division Infinity is IX; VII and VIII are open research charters.** Existing I–VI names and all 62 canonical topic identities remain intact. Provisional VII/VIII research themes are constructive synthesis and evidence-governed evolution; they are not silently frozen as permanent disciplines.

**DODGE** is this package's defined work-contract convention: **Deliverable, Obligations, Dependencies, Guards, Evidence**. Sixteen `K-*` continuity keys preserve source, authority, semantics, state, guidance, evidence, replay, generation, paths, cost, evolution, view, coverage, language, shipping, and research-frontier invariants across outline changes. Codex chooses its own phases; phases cannot erase those obligations.

## 3. Source custody and inheritance

The package preserves all **10 supplied attachment files**, **12 additionally recovered source files**, **8 complete pinned repository trees containing 757 tracked blobs**, and the current owner directive and initial intuition transcript. Expanded archives are indexed through 13 unique archive records and 253 members. Full physical source custody comprises **1,034 files**; original and expanded copies are intentionally retained. `tools/verify_package.py` recomputes source SHA256, repository Git blob hashes, archive-member equality and the exact file census.

The eight repository snapshots are PURL, MUSA, SubstrateIO, Grammar in Numbers, Computational Grammar Theory, SNAD, the `abedkadaancom` University site, and the University-referenced SEURL dependency. Every tracked file at each declared commit is present. A snapshot is an identified historical state; Codex must inspect changes on the target rather than assume a mutable remote still has the same head.

Books include the published **Grammar in Numbers** PDF, the published **Computational Grammar Theory** PDF, their available chapter/publication sources, and the University book-composition system. Personalized volumes that depend on an actual participant session are not fabricated.

The separately named **Book of Forms** remains `MISSING-BOOK-OF-FORMS`: its exact identity was not located in the available title searches or pinned source inventory. The Library of Forms, CGT book, GIN book, and book-generation sources are preserved, but none is silently substituted for that title. This is an explicit source-identity gate for the full commission. The spoken **OpenCLAR** product name is also unresolved; OpenClaw appears in the recovered Astra source and is discussed as an identified comparison, not asserted to be the same name.

Every original **96 PolyIA** clause and **156 UCG** section has its own exact-text, source-hashed disposition record in [inherited_obligations.json](registry/inherited_obligations.json). The supplemental registry covers **130 unique documents**, **3,706 exact-text segments**, and **252 delegated core clause spans**. Its full selected partition reconstructs **1,055,041 source bytes** without gaps or overlaps. Segment totals include context and formatting; they are not counts of independent legal or mathematical duties. Source custody and mapping do not assert that every retained source implementation is correct or executed.

The recovered University materials include the Haq Roots constitution, Living Press relay, Grammar in Ciphers packet, and HOMELESS/DARK University bridge. All original bytes remain intact. Corrections, changed decisions, and current authority are separate linked records. Historical labels such as “sample,” “preview,” or “seed” do not authorize omission.

## 4. What runs now

The bootstrap provides:

- A SQLite journal containing complete event payloads, captured artifact bytes, versioned source context, strict typed comparisons, deterministic state replay, stable receipts and guarded concurrent writes.
- `PRODUCE → VERIFY → ACCEPT`, with re-production invalidating the current verification while retaining history. Unsupported mission verifiers remain explicitly unsupported.
- `SUBMITTED → ACKNOWLEDGED / DEFERRED / REJECTED`, followed by actual `APPLIED` events only for registered guidance actions: priority, pause and resume.
- Real authenticated HTTP commands, read-only observer scope, machine discovery, OpenAPI, event/checkpoint inspection and a usable human commissioning workbench.
- Exact rational polynomial identities and domain exclusions, finite grammar-as-letter promotion with distinct expansion and denotation checks, and typed paths requiring multiple joint premises.
- A finite worker and optional supervisor timer for repeated registered experiments. Applied pause guidance takes effect before the next invocation. Arbitrary research discovery is a later commissioned capability.

The Python runtime uses the standard library. It has no model weights or third-party inference dependencies. Its scientific audit runs the exact seed kernels with network/process operations intercepted. The commission additionally requires broader no-inference verification as future grammar, intake, native compiler and generator capabilities are implemented. An optional model client cannot become a hidden baseline dependency.

### Quick local run

Use Python 3.11+ on a supported POSIX system and a patched SQLite build; see the runbook's exact SQLite preflight. Choose fresh disposable directories for this example:

```bash
python3 tools/verify_package.py --require-release-manifest
python3 tools/audit_no_llm.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
mkdir -p /tmp/polyia-demo-artifacts
python3 -m polyia init --state-dir /tmp/polyia-demo-state --workspace /tmp/polyia-demo-artifacts
python3 -m polyia demo --state-dir /tmp/polyia-demo-state --workspace /tmp/polyia-demo-artifacts
python3 -m polyia verify --state-dir /tmp/polyia-demo-state --workspace /tmp/polyia-demo-artifacts
```

For the local interface, supply a strong bearer token through the environment; enter it in the web page when prompted:

```bash
read -rsp 'Operator token: ' POLYIA_OPERATOR_TOKEN
export POLYIA_OPERATOR_TOKEN
python3 -m polyia serve --state-dir /tmp/polyia-demo-state --workspace /tmp/polyia-demo-artifacts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
```

Open <http://127.0.0.1:8765/>. Public discovery is `/.well-known/polyia.json`; private state and commands require authentication. These local commands do not create the future Oracle/public URL. The runbook provides the real-target installation and independent-client evidence contract.

Optional development checks with Node 20+ are `node --test web/client.test.mjs` and `node --test web/ui.test.mjs`. They use the actual Python service. UI-handler tests use a test-only DOM; real-browser rendering and accessibility remain a separate target acceptance gate.

## 5. Completion and evidence

`evidence/RELEASE_VERIFICATION.json` records the final observed test commands, environment and results. The original independent review and its remediation review are retained. A clean-unpack release check verifies that the archive is sufficient without depending on the authoring workspace.

The bootstrap has **194** requirement definitions: **192 mission obligations** and **2 explicitly narrower BOOT checks**. Full mission verifiers are intentionally not replaced by generic integrity checks. A receipt that says a command committed successfully is distinct from the scientific outcome stored within it. Failed, refused, inconclusive and unsupported results remain readable.

The complete future Poly IA application must ingest supported prompts/articles without LLM inference; preserve source spans; derive typed interpretations and relationships; construct admissible improvements; separate proven or observed results from experimental opportunities; and expose all of this to humans and machine clients. It must implement the inherited native compiler/packages and subject-specific acceptance detail. After that finite commission contract passes, the continuing University mandate expands the research frontier under the same source, guidance, experiment and versioning discipline.

No remote repository write or Oracle deployment was performed to construct this package. Source custody is complete for the identified preserved inputs; the exact Book of Forms identity is openly unresolved. The package is ready for execution in this checkout with actual target access. The subsequent owner-authorized GitHub publication is recorded separately in [GITHUB_HANDOFF.md](docs/GITHUB_HANDOFF.md).
